main.description: This keeper is happy for their pets to be Pet of the Week on Bluesky, with an @mention. The record existing is the yes; deleting it is the no. ⚠ PUBLIC ON PURPOSE, unlike pet.trezy.preferences: the weekly pick has to read it and cannot read a permissioned space, and agreeing to be posted about in public says nothing private. Not signed: forging your own consent is consenting, and a copy in anybody else's repo is never read.
